data_references.description: Raw flow cytometry and unmixed spectral flow cytometry data will be made available

code_references.description: Open-access GitHub repository containing detailed protocols and analysis workflows for EpiFlow spectral flow cytometry method

key_results.description: Manual gating strategies to select high quality events and identify neuronal progenitor cells with histone H3-PTM fluorescence values
Visualization of manual gating and unsupervised clustering in opt-SNE two-dimensional space showing 11 FlowSOM elbow metaclusters consolidated into 10 clusters
High-dimensional exploration of H3-PTM profiles across clusters showing distinct chromatin modification profiles in NPC Clusters 08, 09, and 10
Dose-dependent changes in H3K27ac, H3K4ac, and H3K9ac marks with TSA and SAHA treatment
Dose-dependent changes in histone acetylation with A-485 treatment
H3K4me1 fluorescence intensity changes across cell cycle phases with drug treatments

methods_summary.study_design: in vitro experimental study using human induced pluripotent stem cells and neural progenitor cell derivatives
methods_summary.sample_size: n=3 biological triplicates for all experiments
methods_summary.analysis_pipeline: 1) Cell culture and neural induction of hiPSCs to NPCs, 2) Drug treatments with histone modifying compounds, 3) Sample preparation with fixation and permeabilization, 4) Spectral flow cytometry staining with multiparameter antibody panel, 5) Data acquisition on Cytek Aurora analyzer, 6) Data unmixing with SpectroFlo, 7) Manual gating for quality control and cell population identification, 8) Unsupervised clustering using FlowSOM algorithm, 9) Dimensionality reduction with opt-SNE, 10) Statistical analysis and visualization in R

data_availability_statement: Data analysis code and details of R packages used are available at [https://github.com/SerranoLab/Golden_etal_2024]. Raw flow cytometry and unmixed spectral flow cytometry data will be made available in FlowRepository.
code_availability_statement: A comprehensive analysis and data visualization code, including input data, data processing steps, and visualization rationale, is available at [https://github.com/SerranoLab/Golden_etal_2024]. The data analysis workflow for gating and dimensionality reduction was built using the cloud-based OMIQ analysis platform. The data exploration and visualization workflow was built in R using the renv package (Renv v1.0.7), which creates reproducible R environments and ensures data analysis reproducibility.
